features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Implement a user authentication system to ensure that only authorized users can access the system and its features.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: The requirements do not specify user authentication, but it is a common security feature for systems that handle data collection and reporting.

features.name: Data Security
features.description: Implement measures to ensure the security and privacy of the collected data, including encryption and access controls.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: Data security is a fundamental aspect of any system dealing with data collection and reporting, yet it is not addressed in the extracted features.

features.name: Keyword Suggestion
features.description: Provide keyword suggestions based on user input to enhance search accuracy.

features.name: Keyword History Tracking
features.description: Maintain a history of previously entered keywords for user reference.

features.description: Handle errors during keyword input, data collection, and report generation.

features.name: Data Storage
features.description: Store collected data and reports for future reference.

features.name: Report Export
features.description: Allow users to export the generated trend report in various formats (e.g., PDF, Excel).

features.name: Report Formatting
features.description: Format the trend report into a user-friendly layout.

features.name: Report Export
features.description: Allow users to export the formatted report in various formats (e.g., PDF, Word).

features.name: Data Source Management
features.description: Manage and configure various data sources from which the system collects information related to the keywords.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: While data collection is mentioned, the management of data sources is not explicitly covered, which is essential for ensuring data quality and relevance.

features.name: User Interface Design
features.description: Design a user-friendly interface that allows users to easily input keywords, view reports, and navigate the system.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: The requirements do not mention the importance of a user interface, which is critical for user experience.

features.name: Performance Metrics
features.description: Track and report on the performance of the system, including response times and data processing speeds.
acceptance_criteria: Reason missed: Monitoring performance is crucial for maintaining system efficiency and user satisfaction, but this aspect is missing.
